storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
The keeper of the Awakener records has moved her file to the Student Administration Office more than once, and every time she has carried it back herself, to be buried again under the mountains of paperwork.
"Just leave it here. It'll have to go over eventually."
Her voice is as calm as ever. Her eyes are not.

What kind of storm is she keeping under all that calm?

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Ramona's first appearance on campus caused an uproar.
At Mythag University, where Awakeners wander the halls and oddities are everywhere, silver hair and mismatched eyes were hardly worth a second look. What made Ramona the talk of the school was that she was the professor's daughter.
Everyone crowded outside the mathematics department office, hoping for a glimpse of the young Miss Dexter. There were so many of them that the professor finally had to call on Miss Lotan before the crowd grudgingly broke up.
Once Ramona was a little older and the professor was finally willing to let her roam the campus on her own, the students Lotan had chased off got their chance to talk to her after all.
"What is Lady Dexter like? I'm afraid no such person exists yet. I'm an orphan. My father was kind enough to take me in."
To be rid of them, the little girl stated the facts without flinching, then strolled off while they stood there feeling guilty.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
From the age of ten, Ramona was a fixture at the university training grounds. A human girl willing to take instruction from the black-clad swordsman—plenty of Investigators admired her for that alone.
Once she formally began the preparatory courses, her flawless memory, her perfect papers, and her elegant, lethal swordsmanship pushed her standing at Mythag higher and higher. Discipline and excellence became her other names.
What puzzled so many was that for all her brilliance, Ramona was never cleared to take a mission on her own. Admitted early, she spent a full five years in preparatory courses, watching class after class of Investigators leave for the world of the occult.
What was she waiting for? What purpose had been laid on her?
The question was answered when the new Keeper enrolled.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Dreams are memory thrown back at us, daily life in miniature, the sum of a person.
Since she was small, Ramona has had the same dream again and again.
She floats in warm, clouded water, pressed close to something unknown, while a hollow, monotonous drumbeat sends ripple after ripple through the water.
When she wakes, there is always a hollow somewhere inside her, as if something had been taken out of her life and erased.
But to keep her father from looking worried, to keep from adding one more burden to her already overworked teachers, Ramona swallows the questions clawing up her throat and goes back to ordinary days.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
She knows everything.
She knows the bell tower rings when there's an emergency, that the Eridanids will come again in ten years, that a different kind of power runs in her blood.
She knows nothing.
She doesn't know the secret spice in the cafeteria curry, or how to calculate a planet's radius after annihilation, or where her own future is being pulled.
She can't bear to give up anything around her, and she can't resist the road her instincts point down.
On the way toward truth, Ramona needs steady company—someone to hold open the road back to ordinary days.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Ramona Dexter, just call me Ramona. I'm looking forward to working with you, Keeper.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Shortcut methods may give a boost, but don't neglect skill training.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: So this method applies to me as well...

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: A wonderful feeling.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: It feels like something is boiling inside me. Is this what it feels like to undergo Enlightening?

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Besides combat ability, my memory and logical thinking haven't improved much. Indeed, I shouldn't rely on something else to think for me.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: It feels as refreshing as reading "On the Origin of Species" in one go.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: I've gotten stronger. Let me try handling the next mission alone, alright?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Now, the line between me and the Awakener is even blurrier. Take good care of me, will you?

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: Let's go. We have a world to save.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Whether it's the Awakener Affairs Office procedures or the date for Indian food in the canteen, I can answer any question about Mythag for you. Don't worry, you're not bothering me. Do I look that unapproachable?

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Are you curious about my relationship with Professor Dexter? It's no secret. He is my foster father. As for my mother... I grew up here at the school and was cared for by all the teachers. However, among them, I am closest to Professor Doll.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: You've met that woman, right? The Awakener in a white veil—she's one of the university's founders... But honestly, I don't like her. That aloof attitude, as if she doesn't care about the world at all, really gets on my nerves... Oh, you think she looks like me? Let's go get your eyes checked at the campus clinic.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Ah... It's natural for you to have concerns. I didn't think it through. As your partner, I should have explained this from the start. As you can see, I do possess some unusual traits, likely tied to my background. It's impossible not to be curious, right? But having a place like the academy is a blessing for me, so I choose not to lift the veil of fate.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: "With such abilities, am I truly still human?" I have asked myself this every day since I started training for battle. I love this world, despite its darkness, filth, and monotony, but your presence makes it shine like diamonds amidst the dust. I once feared that as my power grew, my stance as a human would shift... Now, I am grateful to have you by my side. Our bond anchors me firmly to the human world. Please continue to watch over me, Keeper.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: You don't know what to do? If you're bored, just go write up some mission reports.

daily.title: Chat: About Studying
daily.content: Your assignment is done, right? Can you come with me to the downtown... Eh? Your math homework isn't done yet?! Ah... sorry, I didn't expect anyone not to understand calculus... Let me help.

daily.title: Chat: About Jenkin
daily.content: I hope Jenkin and Brown are enjoying their time at the academy. Father's cufflinks are insignificant. If Jenkin wants them, she can have them. I'm sure he has a whole box of spares.

daily.title: Chat: About Thais
daily.content: You'd better not get too close to Lady Thais... No, I'm not jealous. I'm just afraid someone might fall for her tricks.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Dissolution is the reason this academy was founded and why we met. To save humanity's spark from Dissolution, let's do our best, partner.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: If you want to know about the academy's past, I suggest you look through the archives. Come on, including its predecessor, that's a history spanning 300 years! You don't really expect me to recount it year by year, do you?

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: I don't have any particular favorites. If I had to say, the feeling of going out on missions is quite nice.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Theory classes are pretty boring. I secretly read investigation records at the back of the classroom. Don't tell Doll this. It's our secret, okay?

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: I've been looking forward to your arrival even before you were officially admitted. It seems we're working together quite well, huh? Partner.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Good job! Do you still have the energy to keep going?

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: I guess... human strength has its limits...

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: Dive into the depths of free will!

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: With this deductive reasoning device... I shall interpret the world!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: This is how we will comprehend the world's mysteries.
